messages:
eli: Heads up — new hire couldn't run `redwoodctl localtest` after installing from our apt repo. They passed `--profile=workshop` but the CLI still started with the 'system' profile.

maria: ok can you paste `redwoodctl config resolved`?

eli: output: `profiles scanned: /etc/xdg/redwood/profile (system), /home/nh/.config/redwood/profile (workshop). requested_profile: workshop. active: system`.

jon: that sounds like the resolver's first-match wins bug. --profile should force an exact name match across scanned paths.

eli: interesting twist — the package postinst created `/etc/xdg/redwood/profile` file during apt install with content `name: system`. It looks like packagers ship a default profile to ease demos.

tina: shipping a system profile isn't inherently bad, but it must not override explicit user choices. We should patch resolver precedence.

maria: can the user workaround by setting REDWOOD_PROFILE env var?

eli: they tried `REDWOOD_PROFILE=workshop redwoodctl localtest start` and it still picked system. So env is ignored in favor of system XDG path.

jon: that's two bugs: 1) resolver precedence wrong (system XDG wins over ENV/CLI), 2) installer is creating a system profile that collides with common demo profile names.

ci-bot: Created ticket DEVEX-912 for resolver precedence.

jon: repro steps: apt install redwoodctl on Debian 12, create ~/.config/redwood/profile with name 'workshop', run `redwoodctl config resolved --verbose`. Observed system wins.

eli: quick local workaround: move /etc/xdg/redwood/profile -> /etc/xdg/redwood/profile.disabled then restart localtest. Not great for onboarding.

maria: proposed fix: when requested_profile present, resolver should scan all load paths and prefer exact name matches before falling back to path order. Add unit test for symlinked/system-installed profiles.

jon: packaging note: stop auto-creating symlink to a user path in postinst and instead put default profile under /usr/share/redwood/examples or similar. Filed PKG-74.

eli: I'll add a short blurb to the quickstart: "If localtest appears to ignore your profile after apt install, check /etc/xdg/redwood/profile and remove or move it."

ci-bot: PR #905 queued: adds resolver unit tests + doc note.

maria: thanks, folks. New hire unblocked with workaround. We'll land the resolver change and packaging update together. :thumbsup:
